title: Plan-Fee Advance After Returned Rent Payments — Community Rules & Site Care Billing Note
content:
A resident with returned site-rent payments prepays plan fees with the past-due payment on the Community Rules & Site Care statement. The advance turns on the returned payments on the Home-Site Lease ledger within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date:

| Returned payments on the Home-Site Lease ledger within the 12 calendar months | Plan-fee advance |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 months of the plan fee in force |
| exactly 1 | 1 month of the plan fee in force |
| none | none |

The advance is added to the payment after every amount allowed to stay on the statement has been subtracted and the zero floor applied.

## Hypothetical cases

Plan fee in force of $50.00, chosen for illustration:

| Returned payments in the 12 months | Advance added |
|---|---|
| 3 | $100.00 |
| 1 | $50.00 |
| 0 | none |

A resident whose remainder after the subtractions is $0.00 and who has 2 returned payments pays $100.00: the advance is added after the zero floor, not absorbed by it.
